benchmark_name: Preauthorized Conjugation-2A multi-source natural 3pl glide challenge v12

answer_sources.feature_resolution: The printed clause has overt plural subject muslimiinta and finite predicate aaddiyaan; 3pl is resolved from subject agreement and present indicative from the clause/form context.

answer_sources.source_family: Kapchits 2005 Sentence particles in the Somali language
answer_sources.feature_resolution: The printed proverb has a coordinated substantive subject and finite predicate aammusiyaan; surrounding discussion explains subject-pronoun omission in these waa proverbs. 3pl is resolved from plural agreement and present indicative from the construction/form context.

measured_result.unknown_safety: 8/8 for combined runtime and master exact

experimental_design.purpose: Test whether the already-reviewed C2A 3pl i-vowel-glide process generalizes after freeze to two independently class-preauthorized lemmas attested in two unrelated natural-source contexts.

independence_limits.reason: v12 deliberately tests two naturally attested 3pl finite surfaces rather than a full paradigm. Surface forms are explicit; person/tense/mood labels are resolved from the attested syntax and finite construction.

notes: Stage 1N merged aaddi, aammusi, abhi and afceli as reviewed C2A class-only entries before any finite answer-source search. Stage 1M kept them outside the activation allowlist through the v12 freeze and baseline measurement. The first successful untouched measurement found 0/2 surface recognition, 0/2 complete deep-feature rows, no exact or rule-derived target hits, and 8/8 unknown safety. The historical baseline is now locked, but current runtime scores are allowed to improve later through uniform activation of the complete Stage 1N cohort using already-reviewed C2A rules. v12 answer rows may never be used to special-case either target.
